benchmarks.name: Epoch Capabilities Index (ECI)
benchmarks.description: Cross-benchmark composite metric combining 40+ AI benchmarks into a single 'general capability' scale. Calibrated so that Claude 3.5 Sonnet = 130 and GPT-5 (medium) = 150. Linear scale: a 10-point jump represents equivalent capability gain regardless of position. Methodology paper 'A Rosetta Stone for AI Benchmarks' (Google DeepMind funded) infers benchmark difficulty statistically from overlapping model results, weights harder benchmarks more, and avoids inflation from specialized models. Domain-specific subsets available (Software Engineering, Math).

benchmarks.name: Epoch Capabilities Index — Software Engineering
benchmarks.description: Domain-specific Epoch Capabilities Index using only software engineering benchmarks (SWE-Bench Verified, SWE-Bench Pro, Terminal-Bench, Aider Polyglot, etc). Same Rosetta Stone methodology as general ECI applied to software engineering subset only.
